comparison.objective: Route a parcel through a self-closing gate onto a conveyor.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a sprung gate open while the other arm slides a parcel through without contact.
comparison.success_condition: Parcel reaches run-off plate through the gateway; gate shuts; no gate contact or lifting.
comparison.reason: No precision mandrel alignment, impact-driven notch fracture, retained insert protection, or fragment recovery.
